# Life Console

> Life Console (https://life-console.dev) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), keyboard-first planning console in the browser. It shows what to do right now, time-blocks the week from a backlog, counts down every deadline and links each task to long-term goals. It is an installable PWA that works offline, syncs across devices, sends push reminders and can be self-hosted with Docker.

## What it does
- Command Center (NOW card): the time block you should be in, with a live countdown, the task to work on, what comes next, the next deadline and what's left today.
- Plan week: backlog → a 7-hour workload bucket per day → that day's timeline. "Auto time-box" places untimed tasks into free gaps between 08:00 and 21:00 by priority. Large tasks can be planned over several days as a time budget.
- Todo inbox: one-line quick-add with a live parser, e.g. `Read chapter 3 #ST2001 30m due:fri p2 @SIG-02.1 [L]` (estimate, due date, priority 1–5, course/goal links, L/S/D type). Subtasks to any depth, bulk edits, filters.
- Deadlines: every deadline as a ticking countdown, grouped Overdue / Today / This week / Next week / Later, with a month calendar and optional personal target dates.
- Strategy: strategic plans as Vision → goals (PSG) → milestones (SIG) with success criteria and time bounds; tasks link to goals with `@SIG-01.2`. Each plan is also drawn as a goal flow: a dependency diagram on a timeline, from milestones to goals to the vision.
- Focus mode (key F): full-screen timer for the current block and the top three actions.
- Pomodoro-aware planning (default 25/5/15), push notifications with a "Mark done" action, dark and light themes.
- Keyboard: ⌘K command palette, N new todo, F focus, T today, W week, G D deadlines, G S strategy, G I inbox, J/K move, X done, 1–5 priority.

## Accounts, privacy, price
- Free, no ads. Sign in with Google (no passwords stored). Export as JSON or delete the account any time.
- Privacy policy: https://life-console.dev/privacy
- Terms: https://life-console.dev/terms

## Open source and self-hosting
- License: GNU AGPL-3.0 (https://github.com/TJ-coding/life-console/blob/main/LICENSE). The hosted service runs the same code.
- Source: https://github.com/TJ-coding/life-console
- `git clone https://github.com/TJ-coding/life-console.git && cd life-console && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d`: PostgreSQL + app + backup job, about 300 MB RAM.
- Self-hosting guide: https://life-console.dev/docs/self-hosting

## How it compares
- Comparisons with other planners, including where they're the better pick: https://life-console.dev/alternatives
- Life Console vs Sunsama: https://life-console.dev/vs/sunsama
- Free and open-source Sunsama alternatives: https://life-console.dev/alternatives/sunsama
- Open-source and self-hosted planners compared: https://life-console.dev/alternatives/open-source-planners
- Notion Life OS vs Life Console: https://life-console.dev/vs/notion-life-os
- Life Console vs Amazing Marvin: https://life-console.dev/vs/amazing-marvin
- Best time blocking apps compared (Life Console, Sunsama, Akiflow, Structured, TickTick, Super Productivity, Google Calendar): https://life-console.dev/alternatives/time-blocking-apps
- Todoist alternatives for planning your day: https://life-console.dev/alternatives/todoist
- Life Console vs Structured, the visual day planner app: https://life-console.dev/vs/structured
- What it doesn't do: no calendar sync, no integrations with other task apps, no AI scheduling, no native phone apps (installable web app instead; a Mac menu-bar app exists).

## Free templates
- Personal strategic plan template (vision, prioritised goals, measurable milestones, check schedule; printable, with a worked example): https://life-console.dev/templates/personal-strategic-plan (PDF: https://life-console.dev/media/templates/personal-strategic-plan.pdf)
- Weekly planner template with time blocking (backlog, a 7-hour workload per day, hourly schedule): https://life-console.dev/templates/weekly-time-blocking-planner (PDFs: https://life-console.dev/media/templates/weekly-time-blocking-planner.pdf and the one-page daily sheet https://life-console.dev/media/templates/daily-time-blocking.pdf)
- Daily time blocking template (top 3, tasks with minutes, a 7-hour workload bar, an hourly schedule, an evening review; printable): https://life-console.dev/templates/daily-time-blocking-planner (PDF: https://life-console.dev/media/templates/daily-time-blocking.pdf)
